survey: SC2010 multibeam, 1 m grid, uncertainty 0.25-0.30 m
vertical_datum: Low Water Mark, which the DoT survey index records as 0.756 m below AHD. Depths are below LWM, the chart convention; at mean water level expect about 0.76 m more.
source_note: 2 m, 5 m and 10 m depth contours and the four depth bands for the Swan and Canning, plus a fifth class, foreshore. Land is masked using config/coast.json. The blue bands cover only water the multibeam actually measured; water inside the bank that it never reached is the foreshore class, green, because the shallowest sounding in the BAG is -1.10 m and everything shallower is the drying fringe. Do not read foreshore as a depth: it means unsurveyed. Surveyed 2010 and Swan sandbanks move. ORIENTATION ONLY, NOT FOR NAVIGATION.
